out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Package Integrity
violations.observation: Observer three severely dented cans of vegetarian baked beans with other canned foods in the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Food packages such as canned goods shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the food is not exposed to adulteration or potential contaminants. Return all dented and damaged canned goods to your food supplier for a credit. The food employee removed the cans and placed them in the segregated dented cans area. CDI.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: The final hot water sanitizing rinse temperature of the mechanical warewashing machine was below the required 160ºF at 157º.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. The manager directed staff to take all equipment to the other dishwashing machine to sanitize it. Maintenance staff repaired the problem with the unit during the inspection. The machine was sanitizing at 162º before conclusion of the inspection. INOVA FFX HOSP/SSB KITCHEN (Inspection Date: 02/10/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Observed several milk crates being used as shelving in the dry storage area and in other locations in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. Please remove milk crates used in this fashion; replace with appropriate shelving or racks, if needed. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the warewashing machine was not sanitizing properly.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. The manager stated there is a problem with the booster heater electrical service. The unit was repaired during the inspection and the machine was sanitizing at 162º before it concluded. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink, in the storage room due to paper towel machine being broken.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC called building maintenance and had paper towel machine battery replaced.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: EHS observed ROP salmon, being thawed inside sealed ROP packaging
violations.corrective_action: EHS had PIC remove salmon form Reduced oxygen packaging, explained why thawing for fish is required to be outside of Reduced Oxygen packaging. PIC updated operating procedure for ROP fish.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black and the thermal plate registered at 115F, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. DUE TO THE VOLUME OF DISHES AND UTENSILS, THIS FACILITY WILL NEED TO OBTAIN REPAIRS AND NOTIFY THE EHS FOR A FOLLOW UP WITHIN 3 DAYS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: turkey sausage on racks (68F), strawberry yogurt (44F) and Tzatziki sauce (47F) in #8.
violations.corrective_action: The food service employee discarded the food items during the inspection for compliance.
